title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Murders and Miracles
One inmate launches a near fatal attack after being in jail for less than an hour; a father accused of murdering his daughter admits to keeping her corpse with him for two years; a female inmate keeps a grim secret from her two best friends.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Brotherhood
Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sucker Punch
After an inmate is assaulted, the jail identifies a suspect, but the violence doesn't stop there; a young inmate gets a crash course on how to survive in jail, as he prepares to deal with the consequences of his actions.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — We Fight
Indiana's Wabash Valley Correctional Facility is an isolated fortress with three officers for every 200 inmates; some inmates find themselves in racial conflict, while others seek conflict elsewhere.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Two Degrees of Murder
A pregnant woman faces the charge of killing her husband two months away from giving birth; her future lies in the hands of a judge; another inmate, also facing a murder charge, pays a price when he disobeys orders.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Words of a Warrior
A two-on-one assault leaves an inmate bloodied and injured, but getting to the bottom of this fight requires some digging; a popular restaurateur, accused of capitol murder, fights for his freedom.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — A House Divided
Former gang members attempt to leave deadly rivalries behind, then the men in another housing unit deal with a completely different set of issues; a surprise contraband raid turns one housing unit upside down.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E1 — Heartless Felons
Life inside the Cuyahoga County Correction Center; members of the jail's most predatory gang set their sights on vulnerable prey; an inmate suffers an apparent breakdown.
